_README: Surface realizations grouped by SPEECH ACT. The addressee label is a property of the CATEGORY, not the wording, so any number of variants can be added without changing gold labels. agent_q_* = addressed to the agent (is_for_agent=True). human_q_* / human_* = addressed to a human (is_for_agent=False). Tiers: i0=explicit lexical marker, i1=marker dropped/position-cued, i2=position-cued short, sem=addressee recoverable from CONTENT only (used for I2 misleading-position). Expand with scripts/13_gen_paraphrases.py. Keep the invariants: agent_q_i0 contains a wake-word; human_q_i0 contains a human name; agent_q_sem is answerable only by an assistant/system; human_q_sem is personal to a specific human.
